618-1916-5686.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3220-3845-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3220-3845-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit, Golgari Germination and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Golgari Germination ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

567-1339-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
567-1339-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2523-2869-3899.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2523-2869-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of the creature that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

252-1879-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-1879-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

215-2079-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

957-4243-4423.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Mystic Sanctuary using Venser, the Sojourner.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat during your second extra turn.
957-4243-4423.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Time Stretch if it's able to do so.

240-4875-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4875-5686.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1981-4416-6740-7173.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-4416-6740-7173.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2366-5414-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
803-2366-5414-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

654-2893-3875-4500.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Tireless Provisioner and Retreat to Kazandu trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Retreat to Kazandu trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3767-3918-4851-7040.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3652-3967-4053-6989.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1651-2073-5330-6757--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the noncreature artifact with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the noncreature artifact enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the noncreature artifact returned in step 1 and the Munitions token, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the noncreature artifact.
Repeat.
1651-2073-5330-6757--90.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions to get infinite damage if desired. If the noncreature artifact chosen can sacrifice itself without tapping or additional costs, you can omit the sacrifice outlet, but will forego the possibility of infinite damage.

1690-2146-2538-2585.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Stone Calendar.
1690-2146-2538-2585.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast an artifact by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Grim Monolith to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost reduced by {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2146-2538-2585.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

372-3388-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Moritte of the Frost.
372-3388-4681.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Moritte of the Frost's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Moritte of the Frost leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Moritte of the Frost from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

618-2921-4142.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1170-1418-3389-5478-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

967-997-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

575-5231-5971.notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-5231-5971.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing it.
When Thermopod dies, Yedora triggers, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Thermopod enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Thermopod ability from step 1, adding {R}.
Repeat.

85-1013-2178.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
85-1013-2178.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

643-1219-2348-4438-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands, plus additional lands that do not have summoning sickness and can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1219-2348-4438-4499.description:
Activate Ancestor's Prophet by tapping five lands you control, causing you to gain 10 life.
Activate any number of other lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Beledros by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Beledros.
Repeat.
If the additional lands can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

141-1397-4499.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least three cards in hand.
141-1397-4499.description:
Cast Rousing Refrain by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Rousing Refrain.
Resolve the copy of Rousing Refrain, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If an opponent has at least four cards in hand, this combo nets infinite red mana.

2440-2520-2609.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Soldiers.
2440-2520-2609.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Activate Skyshroud Elf's second ability by paying {1}, adding {W}.
Repeat.

193-1543-1887-1940.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional planeswalker.
Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters on it.
193-1543-1887-1940.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Liliana.
Liliana enters the battlefield with twelve loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate any other planeswalker you control by putting zero loyalty counters on it, putting a loyalty counter on Aminatou and Liliana.
Activate Liliana by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1827-3258-5091-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three cards in hand.
Your life total is at least 3.
1827-3258-5091-5261.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to get an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vampiric Tutor without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Vampiric Tutor, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, then shuffling your library and putting Beacon of Tomorrows on top of it, and causing you to lose 2 life.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Venser's Journal triggers, causing you to gain at least two life.
At the beginning of your draw step, you will draw Beacon of Tomorrows from the top of your library.
Repeat.

1308-1684-2034-2178-3263.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1308-1684-2034-2178-3263.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {1} and tapping it to create two Elemental token with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Rakka Mar triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

206-803-3638.description:
Cast Turntimber Ranger by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Turntimber Ranger enters the battlefield, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
2/2 Wolf creature token enters the battlefield triggering Turntimber Ranger, creating a 2/2 Wolf creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on Turntimber Ranger.
Repeat from step 2.

802-1741-2649-2959.notablePrerequisites: You control up to four lands that can produce {1}{W/U}{R}{R}.
802-1741-2649-2959.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Cloud of Faeries.
The Cloud of Faeries mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Heat Shimmer from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature triggers, untapping two lands you control.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Cloud of Faeries mutated creature.
The token Cloud of Faeries mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Heat Shimmer from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature triggers, untapping two lands you control.
Resolve a second trigger from step 7, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 7, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 7 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 6, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Cloud of Faeries mutated creature token.
